mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_personal_submissions (assignment_id, student_id, submission_content, submission_files, submitted_at, late_submission, score, feedback, graded_at, graded_by, status, created_at) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{submissionContent}, #{submissionFiles}, #{submittedAt}, #{lateSubmission}, #{score}, #{feedback}, #{gradedAt}, #{gradedBy}, #{status}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO student_personal_submissions (assignment_id, student_id, submission_content, submission_files, submitted_at, late_submission, score, feedback, graded_at, graded_by, status, created_at) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{submissionContent}, #{submissionFiles}, #{submittedAt}, #{lateSubmission}, #{score}, #{feedback}, #{gradedAt}, #{gradedBy}, #{status}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE submission_content = VALUES(submission_content), submission_files = VALUES(submission_files), submitted_at = VALUES(submitted_at), late_submission = VALUES(late_submission), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE student_personal_submissions SET score = #{param3}, feedback = #{param4}, graded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, graded_by = #{param5}, status = 'graded', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE assignment_id = #{param1} AND student_id = #{param2}
